name: Deathstalker Vincent
summary: Inside Shadowfang Keep, Deathstalker Vincent lies slain by Arugal. The Forsaken scout entered the stronghold with Deathstalker Adamant to learn its defenses, but the mission ended before the Forsaken could attack.

sections.title: A Scout's Fatal End
sections.body: The Deathstalkers needed to learn Shadowfang Keep’s layout before the Forsaken could assault it. Vincent and Adamant slipped past the barricades into the fortress. Their mission failed: Adamant was captured and locked in a dungeon cell, while Vincent was brought before the keep’s master. Vincent refused to serve Arugal or yield to him. The mage executed him, leaving his body on the stone floor.

sections.title: Arugal's Defiance
sections.body: Arugal used Vincent’s death to defy the intruders in his keep. Facing the captive scout, the mad mage mocked the Forsaken and compared their intrusion with the failed efforts of his former Kirin Tor comrades. Arugal demanded Vincent’s blade and secrets for his own use. When Vincent refused, Arugal struck him down and declared that his remains would warn anyone who trespassed in his domain.

faq.answer: Vincent was a Forsaken scout in the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken’s intelligence arm. He and Deathstalker Adamant entered Shadowfang Keep to gather intelligence before the planned assault.

faq.q: What happened to Vincent in Shadowfang Keep?
faq.answer: Vincent was captured during his reconnaissance and executed by Arugal after refusing to serve him or give up secrets. Arugal left his body where it fell.

faq.q: Where is his partner, Deathstalker Adamant?
faq.answer: Deathstalker Adamant was captured alive and locked in a nearby dungeon cell, watched by a worgen guard.

faq.q: Why were the Deathstalkers sent to Shadowfang Keep?
faq.answer: Silverpine Forest is vital territory for Sylvanas and the Forsaken, while Arugal’s worgen hold Shadowfang Keep. Vincent and Adamant were sent to learn the fortress’s layout and defenses so the Forsaken could mount an effective attack.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, finding Vincent confirms the Forsaken commanders’ fears in Silverpine: the reconnaissance team failed, and the keep must be cleared by force.
As a rogue, Vincent’s execution shows the danger faced by stealth operatives who infiltrate hostile strongholds alone.
